population: DECLARED, NOT BUILT — no render path emits this Tile. It was described as a `<!-- annotation: … -->` review comment producing a corner overlay; measured on a real render, that comment is swallowed by the speaker-notes channel (`<aside class="lattice-notes" hidden>`) and nothing paints, on any layout. There is no CSS for it. The editorial-note job is done by the ANNOTATION register — an italic-only trailing paragraph, which docks in the `coda` Cell, not here (lib/base/base.modifiers.css § THE TRAILING BEATS' CHROME).
